metadata.datasource:
This profile was created by processing raw measurement data from data-sheets and/or scientific papers. Original data are property of the respective holders.
    Film/photo-paper: Kodak and Fujifilm data-sheets, scientific publications, and technical material.
    Reflectance: Otsu (https://github.com/enneract/otsu2018), Munsell (https://zenodo.org/records/3269912), human skin (https://www.nist.gov/programs-projects/reflectance-measurements-human-skin), forest colors (https://zenodo.org/records/3269920), Japan colors (https://zenodo.org/records/5217752).
    All data publicly available.
metadata.quality: Upstream digitized spectral/characteristic data, fixed supplied 6.5-minute development condition. Other times are not interpolated. Grain/halation use existing engine defaults, not independent Double-X fits. No measured full-image validation.
metadata.conversion: SpektraLab 2026-10-31: select condition index 2 (6.5 min) consistently for curve, base density, sublayers and CDF model; repeat silver sensitivity/curve/model/layers across three channels, split dye density by three to conserve total optical density; norm_cdfs renamed cdfs; omit absent optional null fields. Original five conditions archived; no refit or exposure-axis change.
